# Prepare implementation

## Inputs

- Task: requested behavior and acceptance criteria.
- Repository and project instructions: checkout to change and applicable rules.
- Plan: intended changes and focused test commands.
- PR context: destination, base branch, and any existing PR URL.
- Failure evidence, when repairing: failed commands, results, and diagnosed defects.

Confirm these inputs are available. Use the failure evidence to identify repairs when supplied. Preserve the acceptance criteria.

Return these inputs unchanged for partitioning the implementation.
